scope: Read-only font inventory; no PDF edits or uploads.

addedFontTextUses.text: Feeding and using your compost bin

interpretation: Two added font variants: Nunito Sans SemiBold and Lucida Grande Regular. SemiBold has embedded TrueType programs and a named PDF resource. Lucida Grande Regular renders only the five-eighths fraction at folios 61 and 67; it survives conversion as unnamed Type3 objects 2315 and 2558. This is a focused isolation candidate, not proof of the supplier's rejected Unknown font. Many retained Nunito Sans resources are also converted to unnamed Type3; addition of a font is not the only possible cause of changed supplier behaviour.
